args.message: Brooklyn's longest run of month-over-month growth in pre-tax sales was 6 months, from October 2023 through March 2024. Sales rose each month from $47,249 in September 2023 to $106,350 in March 2024. The next-longest run was 4 months, which happened twice (Oct 2024 to Jan 2025, and Oct 2025 to Jan 2026). Only complete months from June 2023 to September 2026 were counted; June 2023's growth was measured against May 2023.
